meta.name: lsp
meta.description: Use when Codex needs language-server diagnostics, definitions, references, symbols, or rename safety checks in the current workspace.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在编辑器中获取代码诊断、定义跳转和引用查找
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在代码编辑器中快速定位定义、引用或检查重命名安全
copy.tagline_en: Get language diagnostics, definitions, references, and rename safety in your editor
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need quick access to definitions, references, and rename safety in your code editor

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会通过 lsp MCP 工具调用语言服务器：检查文件或目录的诊断、跳转定义、查找引用、查看符号，并在改名前后做校验。
howto.when: 当需要语言服务器诊断、定义、引用、符号或重命名安全校验时触发；诊断报缺少语言服务器时，先查 lsp.status。

say.text: 用 lsp.diagnostics 检查这个文件的错误
say.note: 建议只报 error 级别

say.text: 用 lsp.goto_definition 找这个符号的定义位置
先 lsp.prepare_rename 看这个改名是否合法
say.note: 再用 lsp.rename 应用工作区编辑

howto.what_en: Claude gets LSP MCP tools to check language-server diagnostics, jump to definitions, find references, list symbols, and verify or apply renames in the workspace.
howto.when_en: Triggered when Codex needs language-server diagnostics, definitions, references, symbols, or rename safety checks in the current workspace.

say_en.text: Run lsp.diagnostics on this file and show the errors
Use lsp.goto_definition to locate this symbol
Check with lsp.prepare_rename whether this rename is valid
